As an English teacher with years of experience, I know exactly what English learners want the most: To speak English with a native English speaker. I will provide that for you in a comfortable environment without any pressure. We will have a fun conversation together while building your confidence and improving your fluency.

The biggest challenge English learners face while speaking English is their confidence. Together, we will build your confidence and improve your English to a more natural, native level. You will NOT be laughed at for not knowing a word or saying something wrong. You WILL be encouraged to speak, to practice your English skills, and to make mistakes. I WILL BE RECORDING YOUR MISTAKES THE ENTIRE TIME. From the moment you first message me to when we say goodbye after our lessons, I will record your mistakes and review them with you. Finally, after our class, I will post the feedback to your profile so you can review it whenever you'd like :)

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation & Accent Training
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to the Pronunciation & Accent Training ESL English program! As an experienced language instructor, I am dedicated to helping you develop clear and confident English pronunciation, and to refine your accent to effectively communicate in any English-speaking setting.
In this specialized course, we will focus on several key areas to enhance your pronunciation and accent:
Phonetics & Sounds: We will explore the different sounds present in the English language, paying particular attention to those that may not exist in your native language. Through interactive exercises and drills, you will learn to produce these sounds accurately.
Word Stress & Intonation: Understanding word stress and intonation patterns is essential for natural and expressive speech. You will master the rhythm and melody of English, making your speech more engaging and easy to understand.
Vowel & Consonant Sounds: We will dive deep into English vowel and consonant sounds, addressing common challenges and helping you articulate them with precision.
Reduced Speech & Linking: English speakers often link words together and use reduced speech in everyday conversation. You will learn these techniques to sound more like a native speaker and improve your listening comprehension.
Accents & Regional Variations: While achieving a neutral accent is the primary goal, we also embrace and appreciate various English accents and regional variations. You will gain exposure to different accents, helping you adapt to diverse English-speaking environments.
Remember, perfect pronunciation is not the goal. Our aim is to help you communicate clearly and confidently, embracing your unique voice while developing a solid foundation in English pronunciation!

pro_course_detail.title: General English - Speaking, Grammar, Listening, Vocabulary and Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
Each lesson will contain one or more of each area (grammar, speaking, listening, writing, and vocabulary) and will be tailored to your needs all the while using interesting and relevant topics. I’ll always include tips, resources, and tools to help you reach your language goals. 

Grammar: Practice grammar structures and focus on the areas that are problematic for you and you’ll be given practice exercises and tools that help you grasp grammar concepts.

Speaking: Talk about your favorite topics and hobbies all the while focusing on your pronunciation, intonation, and word stress. Many English learners have a wide vocabulary but sadly aren’t understood because they lack understanding of word stress and intonation. 

Listening: Perhaps you can read and speak English well, but you struggle listening to a conversation. You’ll practice by listening to interesting short audio and video clips and then we will discuss the content. 

Writing: Whether you’re writing an email or an essay, I’ll help you develop your writing skills and focus on content, style, and punctuation. 

Vocabulary: Learning new words is essential as a language learner. In every lesson, you will be exposed to new words and discuss their meaning, range, and pronunciation.

In this class, you will do most of the speaking and I will give you helpful guidance on how to improve your pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation - Mock Interview/Resume/CV Writing
pro_course_detail.description:
As a Cambridge CELTA certified English teacher, I have helped thousands of students reach their language goals and improve their Business English. This is a comprehensive class which will prepare you for eithr a job interview or help you improve your resume/CV in English. How does it work? 

* Interview preparation: Before the class you will provide me with information about the position you are applying for and I will create mock interview questions for your field. I will "interview" you and help you improve your answers and fluency. 

* Resume/CV writing - Before the lesson you will send me your resume/CV and during the class we will discuss my recommendations for improvements and advice on how to maximize your resume for a native audience. 

If you have questions about this class, feel free to send me a message!

It can be used as proof of a student's ability to use English to communicate with native speakers for everyday purposes. Dialogues, videos, vocabulary building exercises and other materials are available and students are free to choose their preferred types of practice. 
The course offers learners the opportunity to develop practical communication skills and will enable learners to become independent users of English, and to be able to use English to communicate effectively in a variety of practical contexts. 
Course materials are for teens (13 years and up ONLY) and adults. This is a level whereby students already have a good grasp of the basics and want to hone their skills, getting errors corrected along the way, while acquiring more advanced grammar and vocabulary, as well as feeling comfortable holding longer conversations. This is a fun and engaging series of classes, learning while having a good time practicing.

pro_course_detail.title: Intermediate/Advanced level/speaking/listening test preparation (B1 - C1)

Practical strategies to help learners achieve results in all areas of the exams - particularly speaking parts 1,2 and 3, listening and reading. Writing may be included at the students' request.
Students can hone their skills using past exam questions and topic prompts. Reading practice includes skimming and scanning, looking for key language within a text, inference, predicting what you will hear, repetition of answers, identifying synonyms and other ways of analysing a text. 
Learn how the exams are assessed and get tips on how to deal with common problems learners have while preparing.  
A series of classes is recommended to make the most of your preparation time and to perfect your skills.

Introduction: Welcome to the "Read an Article" lesson! In this lesson, you will have the opportunity to practice your reading skills, expand your vocabulary, and improve your pronunciation. 

Step 1: Article Selection
For A2-B1 students, we will be using the website https://newsforkids.net/ which provides interesting and age-appropriate news articles. B1-C2 students will have access to https://newsela.com/, a platform that offers articles at various reading levels to suit your proficiency. Select an article that interests you and make sure it is appropriate for your language level.

Step 2: Reading and Note-Taking
During the lesson, you will read the chosen article aloud while I listen attentively. As you read, I will type comments on Skype or in a shared document. These notes will help me identify areas for improvement in your pronunciation and comprehension.

Step 3: Pronunciation Practice
After you finish reading the article, we will focus on pronunciation. We will work together to correct any mispronunciations and ensure that you pronounce words accurately. To aid in this process, I will use phonetic symbols (/ˈsɪmblz/) to explain the correct pronunciation.

One of the best ways to learn a language is through conversation.  We can talk about everyday life or any topics that interest you.  Don't know what to talk about? No problem! We can use conversation cards with random topics, or we can play fun games that promote conversation. 

Do you like homework?  Me too!  Your time is valuable, and homework helps you get the most out of class time. I enjoy sending a short article or video before each class.  You can choose a topic that you are interested in, or I can choose the topic. Then I will bring some interesting discussion questions to class so we will always have something unique to talk about.  The homework is always optional, but it helps you get the most out of our time together.

This is a relaxed type of class. Mistakes are a part of the learning process and allow us to grow. 
I encourage you to take risks, make mistakes, and enjoy the process. Throughout the class, I will take notes on a shared Google Doc with suggestions to help you sound more like a native speaker, as well as new words and phrases.  This way, you can review after class.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you looking for a structured plan that will take you to the next level? Then this class is for you! This course follows a logical sequence. First we will learn new vocabulary words, practice seeing them in context, then practice using them out loud.  We will also cover all the grammar points necessary in order to master the English language.

Since these are private lessons, they are 100% customized to your needs.  Not sure when to use the past perfect? Then we can start with the past perfect.  Or would you rather focus on vocabulary related to business?  You're the boss.  During your first lesson, we will create a learning plan to help you accomplish your goals. But if you're not sure where to start, I can do a short assessment of your current level, and help you decide where to begin.  

This course typically involves reading, writing, speaking, and listening exercises. In order to get the most out of your class time, most of the reading, writing, and listening exercises are given as homework.  This way, we can spend more time speaking during class.  And of course, we will focus more on the skills that are most relevant to your goals.

pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed to help you achieve the best score possible on whichever English proficiency exam you are preparing for.  Using practice exams as a guide, we will pinpoint any weaknesses and fine-tune them.

Before the first class, please send me a message informing me which exam you will be taking and the exam date. This way, we can create a study plan that is specific to your needs. If your exam date is soon, we can get down to business by practicing the speaking portion of the exam, linking words, and exam tips.  If you have several weeks to prepare, we can cover all four portions of the exam. If you have several months to prepare, we can even follow a textbook.
